title: Buyer-Phase Coverage Limits Table, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
Buyer coverage under the Real Estate Service Contracts plans is limited per contract year: one total limit across all items, and a limit for each covered item. A limit of $0.00 means the item is not covered under that plan.

## Limits per contract year (USD)

| Limit | Bridgewell Closing Starter | Bridgewell Closing Standard | Bridgewell Closing Plus | Bridgewell Closing Premier | Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total limit across all items | 10000.00 | 12000.00 | 15000.00 | 20000.00 | 20000.00 | 15000.00 |
| Heating system | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Cooling system | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Ductwork | 0.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 | 750.00 |
| Interior plumbing leaks and stoppages | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 2000.00 |
| Water heater | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 2000.00 |
| Electrical system | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 2000.00 |
| Each kitchen appliance (refrigerator, range, dishwasher, built-in microwave) | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 2500.00 |
| Each laundry appliance | 0.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 2000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Garage door opener | 0.00 | 400.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 |
| Limited roof leak repair over occupied living space | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of reading

- Items not covered (limit $0.00): on the Bridgewell Closing Starter plan, ductwork, laundry appliances, the garage door opener and roof leaks; on the Bridgewell Closing Standard, Bridgewell Closing Plus and Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plans, roof leaks.
- Limited roof leak repair is covered only on the Bridgewell Closing Premier and Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year plans, at $1000.00 per contract year.
- The kitchen appliance limit applies to each kitchen appliance; the laundry appliance limit applies to each laundry appliance.
- Every figure is a limit per contract year of buyer coverage.
